exception_analysis.facts_supporting: The record describes bid-request data as processed solely within the OpenRTB pipeline and purportedly deleted within 300 milliseconds. If substantiated, this would fit the § 1798.140(e)(4) transient-use purpose, which requires that personal information not be sold, disclosed to a third party, or used to build a profile about the consumer.
exception_analysis.argument_strength_rationale: A colorable mapping exists because the 300-millisecond claim tracks the transient-use timeframe, but the record expressly states the exception is not supported by documented data-flow logs or vendor deletion confirmations, leaving all three § 1798.140(e)(4) elements — no sale, no third-party disclosure, no profile-building — unverified on the current record.
